Q5257: The Satavahanas (; Sādavāhana or Sātavāhana, IAST: Sātavāhana), also referred to as the Andhras (also Andhra-bhṛtyas or Andhra-jatiyas) in the Puranas, were an ancient Indian dynasty.

Q12229205: The Uyunid Emirate (Arabic: الدَّوْلَةُ الْعُيُونِيَّة) was a historical Arab emirate centered in al-Hasa that ruled over most of eastern Arabia and Najd. Q730553: The Battle of Myriokephalon (also known as the Battle of Myriocephalum, Greek: Μάχη του Μυριοκέφαλου, Turkish: Miryokefalon Savaşı or Düzbel Muharebesi) was a battle between the Byzantine Empire and the Seljuk Turks in the mountains west of Iconium (Konya) in west-central Anatolia on 17 September 1176, during the Byzantine–Seljuk war of 1175–1179.
Q20410224: The Great Mosque of Amêdî (Arabic: جامع العمادية الكبير Kurdish: مزگەفتی گەورەی ئامێدی), also spelled as the Great Mosque of Amadiya, is a mosque in the town of Amêdî, Kurdistan, Iraq.
